subject: Temporary SLA waiver + one-month credit proposal for ClearSight
messages:
From: Jane Howard <jane.howard@clearsight.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@clearsight.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Incident affecting inference latency (Nov 14)

Hi Lukas —

We saw sustained p95 latency spikes across our inference routes for ~3 hours on Nov 14 during our morning batch windows. That caused job failures and downstream retries across several teams. We need a remediation plan and are expecting some form of credit given the SLA language.

Can you confirm what happened, how you’re mitigating recurrence, and outline an appropriate credit/waiver to make ClearSight whole for November? We’re in the middle of renewal conversations and this matters.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Howard
VP, Technical Ops | ClearSight
[Attachment: incident_timeline.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Howard <jane.howard@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@clearsight.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Incident affecting inference latency (Nov 14)

Hi Jane — thanks for flagging and sorry for the disruption.

Short version: a combination of a transient autoscaler bug and an unusual sequence-length spike in a small percentage of requests caused sustained queueing on the dedicated pool serving your account. Our on-call fixed the autoscaler rule at 08:35 PST and we rolled a hotfix to the routing policy at 09:10. The service has been stable since.

We’ll share a full RCA by EOD Wednesday. In the meantime, I want to propose a temporary remediation package while we finalize the RCA:
- One free month of dedicated capacity (applied as a credit on the Dec invoice)
- A $25k service credit to cover incident impact (applied pro-rata against usage for Nov)
- A technical follow-up: a joint runbook review and a 1:1 with our infra team next week

Can you confirm whether that would be acceptable as an initial step? If you need us to escalate for exec signoff, I’ll loop in Marissa and Karthik.

Best,
Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 45KB)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Temporary remediation package for ClearSight — need exec OK

Lukas — forwarding ClearSight thread. Proposed bundle: 1 month free dedicated + $25k credit + joint runbook. Finance flag: what’s the net ARR impact and precedent?

Notes:
- ClearSight is a mid-enterprise account with strong expansion potential; the renewal is scheduled for Jan 2027.
- This feels tactical rather than contractual beyond the month and one-off credit. We should keep the remediation timeboxed and documented.

Karthik / Jonas — can you weigh in on approval authority and whether we push to an executive signoff?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary remediation package for ClearSight — need exec OK

Marissa — I’m good with the structure but want to tighten the numbers. Suggest: keep the one month credit; reduce the cash credit to $15k (we can offer an additional $10k credit if they sign a 12-month renewal by Dec 15). That aligns incentives and preserves OPEX budget.

Also propose we require acceptance in writing (email OK) that this is a one-time remedial concession and doesn’t amend the SLO terms. I’ll approve up to $15k from my deck; anything above needs OPs/Revenue signoff. Jonas — can you confirm this does not conflict with legal (SLA amendment concerns)?

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Revenue Operations
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Howard <jane.howard@clearsight.ai>, Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 17:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: Proposed concession — one month credit + conditional $15k credit

Jane / Mark — thanks for your patience. Following an internal review, Redwood is proposing the following one-time remediation package for the Nov 14 incident: 

1) One month of dedicated capacity on us (applied to December invoice).
2) A $15,000 service credit applied pro-rata to November usage charges.
3) If ClearSight executes a 12-month renewal for dedicated capacity by Dec 15, Redwood will add an additional $10,000 credit (total potential credit $25,000).

Terms and next steps:
- This is a one-time, remedial concession and does not change the SLO language in your contract.
- Please confirm acceptance by reply to this thread; we will generate the credit memo and apply it to the respective invoices.
- Our infra team will schedule the runbook review and provide the RCA by Wed, Nov 25.

We believe this balances remediation for the impact with a path to mutual commitment. Happy to hop on a call if you want to walk through the math.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Platform Reliability (on behalf of Exec Public Remediation Committee)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: slo_agreement_excerpt.pdf (PDF, 28KB)]
